name: Verde River (Wild: Childs to Horseshoe Reservoir)
gaugeName: Verde River below Tangle Creek, above Horseshoe Dam, AZ
blurb: Remote multi-day Verde Wild River trip through the Mazatzal Wilderness from Childs to Sheep Bridge, then on to Horseshoe Reservoir.

sections.notes: AZ State Parks Paddle Map 2 (2006-07): Childs Mile 17.2 to Sheep Bridge River Access Point Mile 50.5 (33.3 mi; the guide travel-time table says 32.5). Named rapids Class II-III (e.g. Nasty Little Dog Leg, Dog's Foot, Dry Run, Junkyard - all Class III). Group size max 12 on the Wild section. Eagle no-stop zone Dec 1-Jun 30 (guide Mile 36.9-38.1). Fire pan and portable toilet required overnight (order 03-04-06-23-25). Sheep Bridge road (FR 269) needs high clearance/4WD.
sections.accessReview: The Forest Service currently lists FR 502 at FR 708 (Childs Road) closed to motor vehicles. The camping page’s open status does not establish vehicle access or a usable shuttle. Do not plan a vehicle-supported float here until road reopening and usable public launch or take-out access are confirmed.

sections.notes: AZ State Parks Paddle Map 2 table: Sheep Bridge to Horseshoe Dam 10 miles; 'If the reservoir is full, there can be 5 or 6 miles of flat' water. Horseshoe Dam Road (NFSR 205) is closed to motor vehicles November 2–December 31, 2026 unless rescinded (order 03-12-01-26-31). Mesquite Campground next door is closed through Dec 31, 2026.
sections.accessReview: USFS prohibits motor vehicles on Horseshoe Dam Road (NFSR 205) from its Bartlett Dam Road junction to the dam under Order 03-12-01-26-31, November 2–December 31, 2026, unless rescinded. A usable Horseshoe take-out and shuttle are not established for this listing.
